meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

auth.review_note: Compared the runtime article permission with the authentication and Google OAuth guidance. Native lookup uses the existing actor policy and grants no customer or owner privileges.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the retrieval addition to the backend skill against the commerce guides. Article claims use source evidence; product, order and payment projections still use their named data services.

content.review_note: Reviewed shared publication filtering, the public versus agent search modes, exact slug reads and article display after the latest blog UI release. The blog reference explains the preserved public schema and bounded section results.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed public projection, conversation trace and request boundaries in the backend skill and architecture references. The new exposed evidence is limited to public revision and excerpt identifiers and section number.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed public head registration and private Google reporting setup after the owner and customer navigation merge.

http-errors.review_note: Compared file reads and request failure behavior with the scoped error docs and backend skills. Missing or disallowed published evidence remains governed by the existing empty result and request boundary.

interface.review_note: Verified the customer-specific forms, named pagination, address focus, reading layouts and their composition with the deployed owner and storefront controls.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the retrieval addition to the backend skill against the mail guide. Reading article passages requires no mail queue, recipient lookup or message send.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the revised Settings help alongside MCP client setup guidance. The change is confined to public Header menu guidance.

media.review_note: Cross-checked the revised owner UI skill with the current media selection, confirmation and metadata flows. The existing media documentation still describes those operations.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed customer article links and owner Help boundaries. Targeted runtime passage reads only published public content and the existing operator help stays restricted.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the shared knowledge service with the public MCP article schema. The MCP and browser clients still receive title and summary ranking and the same result fields.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend evidence guidance against the deployed customer page base. Article revision evidence is scoped to published retrieval and the remote-commerce persistence and authorization contracts are untouched.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed SettingsService module resolution and Merchant feed guidance. Dropping a retired header slot leaves the saved catalog eligibility inputs intact.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed current source contract workflow and existing golden tests. The updated agent article branch keeps the same release procedures and explicit separation of offline evaluation and live answer accuracy.
